answer: Submitting an answer locks 44 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The shale escrow is released only against a walnut receipt, and the haven audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 27 aliases means carrying 260 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
